title: Pan-Seared Lamb Tagine
description: A paleo-friendly, keto-compliant dish inspired by Tunisian cuisine, featuring tender lamb cooked in a flavorful pan-seared tagine.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pan and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add onion to pan. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper to pan. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add browned lamb back to pan and stir to combine with spice mixture.
Transfer lamb mixture to a preheated oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until lamb is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
